UPDATE public.payments
payment_amount = #{paymentAmount}, currency = #{currency}, paid_at = #{paidAt}, completed = #{completed}, reference_no = #{referenceNo},
transaction_id = #{transactionId},
WHERE payment_id = #{paymentId}
mapper.select: SELECT payment_id FROM public.payments WHERE invoice_no = #{invoiceNo}
SELECT u.email FROM public.payments p JOIN auth.users u ON p.users_id = u.id WHERE p.invoice_no = #{invoiceNo}
INSERT INTO tour.tickets ( packages_id, ticket_amount, users_id, ) VALUES ( #{data.packagesId}, #{data.ticketAmount}, (SELECT id FROM auth.users u WHERE u.email = #{email}) ) RETURNING id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tour.ticket_payments ( tickets_id, payments_id ) VALUES ( #{ticketsId}, (SELECT id FROM public.payments WHERE invoice_no = #{invoiceNo}) ) ON CONFLICT (tickets_id, payments_id) DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT t.ticket_amount * pkg.price FROM tour.ticket_payments tp JOIN public.payments p ON tp.payments_id = p.id JOIN tour.tickets t ON tp.tickets_id = t.id JOIN tour.packages pkg ON t.packages_id = pkg.id WHERE p.invoice_no = #{invoiceNo}
